profile_policy: Use the selected-agents high-reasoning profiles for all four P5 tasks; original M3 settings stay unchanged.

decision.correctness: For each profile, fr must complete at least as many independently accepted attempts as ordinary tools before claiming a benefit.
decision.efficiency: For that profile, at least two task families must have both repetitions accepted in both setups and at least a 10% reduction in their combined matched complete time with fr.
decision.scope: Apply the rule within each round. Different task sets do not isolate an implementation change across rounds. No general savings or population success-rate claim.
decision.failure_accounting: Keep every slot. A late valid patch remains a failed complete attempt. Unstarted time and missing usage or billing remain unknown, never zero.

authorization.source: User selected full comparison with separate validation round

validation.rule: Freeze implementation and initial-round decision before opening validation source; refuse a release that changes during validation.
